subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add channel/account-level heartbeat recipient config for OK acknowledgments only, separate from alert/content delivery?
rationale: Source inspection proves the requested behavior is missing, but adding public channel config affects compatibility, precedence, validation, and the boundary between agent heartbeat delivery and channel visibility.

options.title: Approve OK-Only Recipient Config
options.body: Add a narrow channel or account recipient shape for HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments only, validated through WhatsApp account and allowlist policy.

options.title: Reject New Channel Config
options.body: Document the existing choices of showOk false for silence or agents.defaults.heartbeat.target/to when all heartbeat delivery should go to one destination.

options.title: Defer To Broader Routing Design
options.body: Keep this issue as design input while maintainers choose a cross-channel heartbeat recipient model instead of a WhatsApp-specific field.

recommendation.title: Approve OK-Only Recipient Config
recommendation.body: Add a narrow channel or account recipient shape for HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments only, validated through WhatsApp account and allowlist policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest current history across WhatsApp schema sharing, heartbeat delivery target routing, and prior review context for this issue.
